mappings.note: Translation verse contains the Hebrew title/header (Lamnatzeach...) which is not present in OSMAIN v1 text. OSMAIN starts with 'Til korlederen' but the translation includes full Hebrew script for the superscription and Psalm number context often found in WLC that precedes the actual poetic text or differs significantly in representation.
Translation v2 corresponds to the second half of OSMAIN v1 ('Klapp i hendene...'). The first part of OSMAIN v1 (the title) is not fully matched here as it was handled in v1.
Direct match: 'For HERREN... over hele jorden' matches WLC v3 content.
Direct match: 'Han underkuer folkeslag...' matches WLC v4 content.
Translation v5 contains the main text of OSMAIN v4 ('Han velger ut vår arv...') but ends with 'Sela'. The mapping is exact in content coverage for this verse.
Direct match: 'Gud stiger opp...' matches WLC v6 content.
Direct match: 'Syng lovsang for Gud...' matches WLC v7 content.
Translation v8 contains the first part of OSMAIN v7 ('For Gud er hele jordens konge...'). The second part 'syng en lovsang med innsikt' is also present, making it an exact match for the whole verse.
Direct match: 'Gud regjerer over folkeslagene...' matches WLC v9 content.
Translation v10 corresponds to OSMAIN v9. The text 'Folkenes fyrster har samlet seg...' matches the first part of WLC v10.
